name: moonraker-notify
title: Print Notifications
author: bespoked
description: Sends a push notification when a print finishes, fails, or errors, using Moonraker's [notifier] and the Apprise library. Apprise speaks to about a hundred services from one address: Telegram, Discord, Slack, ntfy, Pushover, email, Matrix, Home Assistant, and more. Paste the Apprise URL for your service (e.g. ntfy://ntfy.sh/your-topic or tgram://bottoken/chatid) and pick which events to be told about. The Apprise library is baked into the package and linked into Moonraker's interpreter at install; no pip ever runs on the printer.
tagline: Get a ping on your phone or chat when a print finishes or fails.

variables.name: APPRISE_URL
variables.description: Apprise URL for your notification service (e.g. ntfy://ntfy.sh/your-topic)

config.label: Notifier name
config.hint: A label for this destination; you can install more than one.

config.label: Apprise URL
config.hint: Your service's Apprise URL. See github.com/caronc/apprise for the format per service.

config.label: Notify on
config.hint: Which print events trigger a notification.
